## Evidence

- Authentication and acquisition permissions
- Catalog navigation/search/pagination and supported formats
- Progress locations and renderer interoperability
- Bookmark/annotation read, create, update, and delete support
- Offline retry, conflict, and deletion behavior
- Maintenance cost and licensing/dependency effects

## Recommendation

Recommend native, OPDS-only, or deferred support with concrete evidence and remaining tests. Additional native-provider commitment needs owner scope acceptance. Exclude credentials, real endpoint URLs, private identifiers, and raw request/response traces.
